title: 第十七章 我火气很大第十八章 脆皮野猪
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;自从上次，在柳扶烟那里，得知了炼丹师的赚钱能力。
顾尘风早就上了心，查阅了不少关于炼丹师的资料。
相府藏书阁中，甚至还有一些，三品以内的丹药丹方。
炼丹师炼丹，只要有一个丹炉，火源，和炼制丹药的原材料。
再通过自己的炼丹技艺，就能炼丹。
其中丹炉和火源，很好解决，难就难在技术和原料上。
顾尘风有悟道台相助，只有要丹方，技术完全可以自学。
所以最大的问题是原料。
炼制丹药的灵材，可都不便宜。
如今他自己还缺钱，自然不可能再花费一大笔资金，购买原料。
顾尘风这几日，早已有了打算。
“还是再去一趟太荒岭吧。”
太荒岭乃是大离王朝境内，一座面积广阔的原始森林。
其中生活着大量源兽，还生长着数之不尽的灵材。
距离帝都最近的区域，不足百里。
当初顾尘风就是前往太荒岭狩猎，发生了意外。
炼制一品丹药，所需的灵材和源兽材料，都能在太荒岭寻到。
数日的斟酌，加上连续三次突破失败。
顾尘风最终决定，前往太荒岭。

“此去太荒岭，不仅要收集炼丹的材料，更是检验我实力的机会。”
顾尘风如今已是通脉境九星修为，而且是内外兼修。
在帝都年轻一辈，也算是一号高手了。
可尴尬的是，他却没多少出手的机会。
为了隐藏实力，避免敌人察觉，即便在相府。
他修炼时，都做的极其隐蔽。
一切修炼过程，都在悟道台，在外界从不展现实力。
加之开天造化诀，玄妙无比，只要顾尘风不刻意激发。
气血蛰伏之下。
连源海境的大姐，和暗中庇护自己的那位高手，都不可能知晓。
而出了相府，身边又有武者护卫随行。
也根本用不着他亲自出手。
这也就造成了顾尘风，修为提升迅猛，但实战经验却严重匮乏。
除了穿越而来时，袭杀那名女杀手。
他连一次，真正对敌实战的机会都没有。

read2(); Since last time, from Liu Fuyan, I learned about the alchemist’s ability to make money.
Gu Chenfeng had already become interested and looked up a lot of information about alchemists.
There are even some third-grade elixir prescriptions in the Xiangfu Library.
To make an alchemy, an alchemist only needs an alchemy furnace, a fire source, and the raw materials for refining the elixir.
Then through your own alchemy skills, you can make alchemy.
Among them, the alchemy furnace and fire source are easy to solve, but the difficulty lies in technology and raw materials.
Gu Chenfeng has the help of the Enlightenment Platform. As long as he needs the elixir recipe, he can learn the technique by himself.
So the biggest problem is the raw materials.
The spiritual materials for refining elixirs are not cheap.
Now that he is still short of money, it is naturally impossible for him to spend a large sum of money to purchase raw materials.
Gu Chenfeng has already made plans these days.
"It's better to go to Taihuang Ridge again."
Taihuang Ridge is a vast virgin forest within the territory of the Dali Dynasty.
There are a large number of source beasts living in it, and countless spiritual materials grow there.
The area closest to the imperial capital is less than a hundred miles away.
When Gu Chenfeng went hunting in Taihuang Ridge, an accident happened.
To refine a first-grade elixir, all the spiritual materials and source beast materials required can be found in Taihuang Ridge.
Several days of deliberation, coupled with three consecutive failed breakthroughs.
Gu Chenfeng finally decided to go to Taihuang Ridge.
"This trip to Taihuang Ridge is not only to collect materials for alchemy, but also an opportunity to test my strength."
Gu Chenfeng is now at the nine-star cultivation level of Tongmai Realm, and he is cultivating both internally and externally.
The younger generation in the imperial capital can be regarded as the number one master.
But the embarrassing thing is that he doesn't have many chances to take action.
In order to hide his strength and avoid being noticed by the enemy, even in the Prime Minister's Mansion.
When he practiced, he did so in an extremely secretive manner.
All the cultivation process takes place on the stage of enlightenment, and the strength is never shown to the outside world.
In addition, the Art of Creation is extremely mysterious, as long as Gu Chenfeng does not deliberately activate it.
Qi and blood are dormant.
Even the eldest sister of the Yuanhai Realm and the master who secretly protects him cannot know.
After leaving the Prime Minister's Mansion, there were warrior guards accompanying him.
There is no need for him to take action himself.
This also resulted in Gu Chenfeng's cultivation improving rapidly, but his actual combat experience being seriously lacking.
Except for attacking and killing the female killer when she traveled through time.
He didn't even have a chance to actually fight the enemy.
